summary: The order on the desk gives the committee access to the records it needs from {office}.
realLife: Truman’s order on equality in the armed services directed federal personnel to provide documents the committee requested.
gates: An executive order assigns an inquiry that needs records held by other offices.
weights: More agencies holding relevant documents favor explicit access provisions.
inGame: needs: the records an executive inquiry may obtain.

turns.what: The committee has to request records individually.
turns.pulledBy: Its order grants no general access.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry tracks each agency's response.

turns.what: The agency supplies a redacted file.
turns.pulledBy: The file contains protected personal information.
turns.writesBack: The production log identifies what was withheld.
